_notes: What vanilla saves of structure starts (StructureStart.createTag), recorded by the asset generator's StructurePieceFixtures.java on a headless vanilla dedicated server in a new world of this seed with structures on. Each case names a start (structure, dimension and start chunk, from the worldgen structures capture). fresh is its save as generated; with place, placed is its save once every chunk its box reaches is decorated. A save is compact SNBT: the start without its Children, then one string per piece.
